verdict.rationale: Rainforest ships an extensive documented REST API (create/update merchant, webhooks, deposits, amount splits) with a reference doc site and an llms.txt for machine-readable docs access, showing a genuine public API surface. However, a probe for standard machine-discoverable API specs (OpenAPI/Swagger) returned 404s across all candidate paths, meaning there's no verified formal schema for automated/agentic API consumption. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec, SDK/client library evidence, and explicit agent-tooling integration guidance.
